Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Alan Bannister?

Alan Bannister is 74 years old.

When was Alan Bannister born?

Alan Bannister was born on September 3, 1951.

Where was Alan Bannister born?

Alan Bannister was born in Montebello, CA.

How tall is Alan Bannister?

Alan Bannister is 5-11 (180 cm) tall.

How much did Alan Bannister weigh when playing?

Alan Bannister weighed 170 lbs (77 kg) when playing.

How many seasons did Alan Bannister play?

Alan Bannister played 12 seasons.

Is Alan Bannister in the Hall of Fame?

Alan Bannister has not been elected into the Hall of Fame.

When was Alan Bannister drafted?

Alan Bannister was drafted by the California Angels in the 1st round (5th) of the 1969 MLB June Amateur Draft from John F. Kennedy HS (La Palma, CA) and the Philadelphia Phillies in the 1st round (1st) of the 1973 MLB January Draft-Regular Phase from Arizona State University (Tempe, AZ).

What position did Alan Bannister play?

Alan Bannister was an Outfielder, Second Baseman and Shortstop.

How many hits did Alan Bannister have?

Alan Bannister had 811 hits over his career.

How many home runs did Alan Bannister have?

Alan Bannister had 19 home runs over his career.

What was Alan Bannister's average?

Alan Bannister had a .270 average over his career.

How many teams has Alan Bannister played for?

Alan Bannister played for 5 teams; the Chicago White Sox, Cleveland Indians, Houston Astros, Philadelphia Phillies and Texas Rangers.

When did Alan Bannister retire?

Alan Bannister last played in 1985.
